thread:
sam: Quick nudge — we're cutting the release branch tomorrow 09:00 PT. Please add any final changelog entries by EOD today. Ping here if you need help with format or if you want me to bundle small fixes.

julia: Quick Q — for infra changes do we use `infra` as component or `infra:` prefix? lint keeps failing.

release-bot: changelog-lint ❗ failed on PR #4321 — missing `component` tag. Allowed components: runtime, api, infra, docs, ui. See /changelog-template.

julia: ok thanks, will add `component: infra`. Also note the lint enforces a short summary (<=140 chars).

anya: FYI pushed tiny docs fix in #4333. Planning to add this entry:

`````
docs: clarify stable API behavior for pagination — docs and examples updated (#4333)
`````

Is that short enough?

release-bot: automated check — changelog-lint: body too long (max 140 chars) on #4333. Suggest trimming to a single-line summary and put details in the PR description.

michael: re: version bump — are we doing a patch or minor? I have a small perf tweak that should go with this release.

sam: I'll do the version bump when I cut the branch. If it's just the perf tweak + docs, we'll go patch. DM me details.

julia: reminder for everyone — one-line summary + impact + PR link. Example:

`runtime: reduce KV cache miss penalty; ~12% token cost savings — #4324`

anya: got it. shortening mine now. :thumbsup: 

michael: trimming mine too. :eyes: 

sam: Last sweep at 18:00 PT. If changelog-lint still fails, either shorten the entry or ask me to merge a lint fix. After 18:00 I'll freeze and cut the release branch.

anya: thanks — will finish by 16:30.

julia: thanks all — ping me if you want me to proof the phrasing before you submit.

sam: appreciate it. :shipit:
